name: Ani Love ~Josou Bishounen Kakumei!~
original_name: あにラブ ～女装美少年革命！～
source: The protagonist, Naoki, lives alone with his older brother Yuuki. One day Naoki comes home and finds a strange girl there; she is, in fact, Yuuki. It seems that Yuuki has started identifying as a woman. Naoki vows to turn his brother back into a man, but starts developing strange feelings toward the female Yuuki.
translation: 主角直树与哥哥优希两人独居。一天，直树回到家，发现屋里有个奇怪的女孩；事实上，她就是优希。原来优希开始认同自己是女性。直树发誓要让哥哥变回男人，却渐渐对女性形态的优希产生了奇怪的感情。
